experience: WorkExp only, not YearsCode or assumed seniority
cleaning: Finite ConvertedCompYearly 1000..1000000 USD/year and WorkExp 0..80; nonempty DevType/Country; deduplicate identical feature+salary records. Bounds fixed before fitting.
split: Profile group is country+role+WorkExp+sorted technology set. GroupShuffleSplit seed20261018,20% test,18.75% remaining valid. Cannot establish respondent/company independence without identity; not a temporal holdout.
selection: Per-family validation MAE then RMSE; test selected families and train median once after persisted selection.
limits: Self-reported total compensation converted to USD/year by Stack Overflow
Not advertised salary, not numeric experience inferred from titles
Sample selection and country coverage bias; no causal skill premium
No new Gemma fine-tune; existing extraction adapter supports Vietnam card contract only
No ITviec source, target or alignment gate
